zh.title: AirAdvisor發布2026機場排名 倫敦希斯洛機場奪冠
zh.summary: AirAdvisor；2026機場排名；倫敦希斯洛16.94分居首
body: 旅行服務公司AirAdvisor發布「2026年機場排名」（AirAdvisor Airport Ranking 2026），評估英美旅客最常使用的23座主要機場。評比結果顯示，英國倫敦希斯洛機場以16.94的總分高居榜首，愛爾蘭都柏林機場則以16.74分位居第二，西班牙特內里費南部機場名列第三。希斯洛機場雖然處理該研究中最大的旅客吞吐量，仍取得全榜最高綜合得分。
該項研究主要針對歐洲與北美洲的主要航網樞紐進行營運績效與旅客體驗評估。評分機制結合了2025年全年的Eurocontrol營運資料、超過110萬則Google旅客評論，以及機場交通成本與接駁距離等公開資料。評分項目包含出港準點率、Google評論、轉乘費用、轉乘距離、購物體驗及Skytrax評分等六大領域，其中出港準點率與旅客評論同為權重最高的衡量項目，準點率單項即佔總分40%。
在具體營運表現方面，評估涵蓋的所有機場平均出港準點率為74%。儘管希斯洛機場奪得綜合排名第一，其出港準點率為79.1%；法國波爾多梅尼雅克機場則以83.5%的出港準點率奪得單項冠軍，美國洛杉磯國際機場以81.7%緊隨其後。相較之下，法國巴黎戴高樂機場的出港準點率僅有61.1%，在受評的23座機場中表現墊底。
從區域分布來看，歐洲機場在綜合排名中表現強勁，搶下前十名中的八個席次，羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場與阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場亦名列前七大樞紐。北美洲僅有洛杉磯國際機場與奧蘭多國際機場擠進前十名。AirAdvisor執行長Anton Radchenko指出，長期延誤的機場多因容量限制與地勤作業瓶頸等結構性因素所致，此類問題難以在短期內自動改善。

en.title: London Heathrow Tops AirAdvisor 2026 Global Airport Rankings
en.summary: AirAdvisor 2026 ranking; London Heathrow leads with 16.94 points
body: Travel company AirAdvisor has released its AirAdvisor Airport Ranking 2026, evaluating 23 major gateways most frequently utilized by passengers from the United Kingdom and the United States. London Heathrow Airport achieved the highest overall score of 16.94 to claim the top spot in the global study. Dublin Airport finished in second place with a score of 16.74, while Tenerife South Airport placed third. Heathrow secured the leading ranking despite managing the largest passenger volume among all airports included in the evaluation.

The study assessed major transatlantic hubs across Europe and North America based on operational performance and passenger experience. Ranking scores were compiled using full-year 2025 Eurocontrol operational data, more than 1.1 million Google passenger reviews, and publicly available data on airport transport costs and transfer distances. Performance was weighted across six distinct criteria: punctuality, passenger reviews, transfer costs, transfer distance, shopping experience, and Skytrax ratings. Punctuality proved to be the single most heavily weighted factor, accounting for 40% of the total score.

Across all 23 evaluated airports, the average on-time departure rate stood at 74%. While London Heathrow achieved an on-time departure rate of 79.1% to secure first place overall, France's Bordeaux Mérignac Airport recorded the highest individual punctuality rate in the study at 83.5%. Los Angeles International Airport ranked second in on-time departures at 81.7%. Conversely, Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport recorded the lowest punctuality performance among the evaluated gateways, with an on-time departure rate of 61.1%.

European gateways dominated the top tier of the study, taking eight of the top 10 positions overall. Rome Fiumicino, Amsterdam Schiphol, and Dublin all secured places within the top seven. Los Angeles International and Orlando International were the only North American airports to break into the top 10. Commenting on the findings, AirAdvisor Chief Executive Officer Anton Radchenko noted that chronically delayed airports suffer from underlying structural challenges, including airport capacity limits and ground handling bottlenecks, which persist across operating seasons.

zh.title: 捷星航空宣布2027年起收取頭頂置物箱費用
zh.summary: 捷星航空；2027年2月2日起；頭頂置物箱收費；單程25澳幣起
body: 澳洲低成本航空公司捷星航空（Jetstar Airways）宣布，將自2027年2月2日起執飛的航班實施新手提行李政策，開始對使用機艙頭頂置物箱的經濟艙乘客收費。航空公司表示，這項新措施旨在加快乘客登機速度並減少登機過程中的壓力。
在新的行李規範下，捷星航空將取消長期實行的7公斤手提行李重量限制，全面改採尺寸限制制度。所有票種均包含一件免費的座墊下方行李，例如背包、手提包或電腦包，尺寸限制為最高40公分、寬30公分、深20公分。乘客若需攜帶較大型手提行李進入機艙並放置於頭頂置物箱，則需購買「優先手提行李」（Priority Carry-on）服務。

購買優先手提行李服務的乘客同時享有優先登機權益，可在一般登機開始前先行登機並確保頭頂置物箱空間。適用頭頂置物箱的手提行李重量上限提高至10公斤，尺寸不得超過56x36x23公分。該服務將採限量供應，單程起價為25澳幣，具體費用視航線而定。捷星航空執行長史蒂芬妮·塔莉（Stephanie Tully）指出，過往測量行李重量與爭奪置物箱空間是旅客與機組人員的主要痛點，改為尺寸限制後將使打包更簡單，有助於維持航班準點率。
捷星航空補充說明，對於在2027年2月2日之後出發且已經完成訂位的現有乘客，將免費提供優先手提行李權益；託運行李額度與規定則保持不變。此外，捷星航空也是澳洲與紐西蘭首家明確對頭頂置物箱使用權收費的航空公司，此舉類似歐洲低成本航空公司如瑞安航空（Ryanair）、易捷航空（easyJet）與威茲航空（Wizz Air）已實行的附加服務模式。

en.title: Jetstar to Introduce Overhead Locker Fees for Economy Passengers from February 2027
en.summary: Jetstar; overhead-bin fees from 2 February 2027; Priority Carry-on from A$25 one-way
body: Australian low-cost carrier Jetstar Airways has announced that it will begin charging economy passengers for access to overhead locker space on all flights departing from February 2, 2027. According to the airline, the new policy is designed to streamline the boarding process and mitigate cabin baggage stress for both passengers and crew members.

Under the overhauled baggage policy, Jetstar is replacing its existing 7kg carry-on weight limit with a size-based framework. Every fare tier will continue to include one complimentary underseat personal item, such as a handbag, small backpack, or laptop bag, measuring up to 40 x 30 x 20 cm. Passengers wishing to bring a larger cabin bag on board to store in the overhead bins will be required to purchase the airline's new Priority Carry-on option.

The Priority Carry-on add-on permits passengers to store a cabin bag weighing up to 10kg with maximum dimensions of 56 x 36 x 23 cm in the overhead lockers. It also includes priority boarding privileges, allowing passengers to board earlier and secure bin space before general boarding commences. The optional service will be offered in limited quantities starting from A$25 one-way, with pricing varying according to the specific flight route. Jetstar Chief Executive Officer Stephanie Tully stated that carry-on weighing and locker space competition were major travel friction points, adding that the shift to a size-focused model aims to improve on-time departures while preserving low fares.

The airline confirmed that existing passengers who booked prior to the policy announcement for travel after February 2, 2027, will receive Priority Carry-on access at no additional charge. Checked baggage rules and allowances remain unchanged under the new policy. Jetstar represents the first airline in Australia and New Zealand to introduce explicit fees for overhead bin access, adopting an ancillary revenue strategy pioneered by European low-cost carriers including Ryanair, easyJet, and Wizz Air.
